info.title: ACME Compensation API (frontend subset)
info.description: Backend API for the Next.js server. Browsers do not call it directly; no CORS is enabled.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a two-hour session token
post.description: Five failed attempts per caller and email address per 15 minutes; successful logins do not count.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS: unknown email, wrong password, or inactive user (one response).

get.summary: Current HR user, scopes, and session expiry

post.summary: Revoke the session (safe to repeat)

get.summary: Search, filter, sort, and page the employees in the caller's scope
get.description: Scope, filters, sorting, LIMIT, and OFFSET all run in MySQL. Totals count only employees in scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Employee ID (exact or prefix), first, last, or full name (partial, case-insensitive), or exact email (case-insensitive). "%", "_", and "\" are literal.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the selected compensation record.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Salary sorts compare unrounded USD values computed in MySQL from the saved rate, and require comparisonCurrency=USD. Ties break on employee ID.

parameters.name: comparisonCurrency
parameters.description: Required when sort is a salary field.

200.description: One page. A page after the last page has no rows and correct totals.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid, unknown, or repeated parameter; salary sort without comparisonCurrency=USD; or salary sort with no saved INR rate.

get.summary: One employee with selected compensation and full compensation history

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown and out-of-scope employees return the same body.

get.summary: Filter and sort values available inside the caller's scope

200.description: Values present in scope. Salary sorts are omitted when no rate is loaded.

post.summary: Ask the read-only compensation assistant
post.description: Read-only. The server derives identity and scope from the Bearer token. Tools return permission-filtered cards; the answer text is model-written. At most 4 tool rounds and 45 seconds per request.

200.description: The answer, tool calls, cards, and limitations.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid conversation.

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: no model configured, model timeout, or provider error. Other routes are unaffected.

post.summary: Preview one salary adjustment (writes nothing)
post.description: Returns exact old and new values, the salary band, warnings, and a five-minute preview token. confirmationMode is DIRECT_APPLY for Admin HR and SUBMIT_REQUEST for Scoped HR.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, with a reason such as PREVIEW_EXPIRED, PREVIEW_MISMATCH, SALARY_BAND, PERCENTAGE_RANGE, PAST_EFFECTIVE_DATE, FUTURE_CHANGE_EXISTS, NOTE_REQUIRED, or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown and out-of-scope employees return the same body.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: database unavailable or a lock wait timed out. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Admin HR: apply the exact previewed adjustment
post.description: Creates one immutable compensation version and marks any pending request STALE, in one transaction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per operation attempt; reuse it only to retry the same command. The same key with the same command returns the original result (with an Idempotency-Replayed: true header); with different data it returns DUPLICATE_OPERATION.

201.description: The new compensation version (or the original result for a replay).

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, with a reason such as PREVIEW_EXPIRED, PREVIEW_MISMATCH, SALARY_BAND, PERCENTAGE_RANGE, PAST_EFFECTIVE_DATE, FUTURE_CHANGE_EXISTS, NOTE_REQUIRED, or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

409.description: STALE_VERSION (fetch and confirm a fresh preview) or DUPLICATE_OPERATION.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: database unavailable or a lock wait timed out. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Scoped HR: submit the exact previewed adjustment for approval
post.description: Creates one PENDING request and no compensation record.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ALL includes inactive users.

parameters.description: Users whose access includes this country. Admin HR matches every country.

parameters.name: department

parameters.description: Default: desc for updatedAt, asc for name and email.

post.summary: Admin HR: create the exact previewed HR user
post.description: Generates a random temporary password and returns it once, in this response only. Only its Argon2id hash is stored. No email is sent. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the user with temporaryPassword null.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per operation attempt; reuse it only to retry the same command. The same key with the same command returns the original result (with an Idempotency-Replayed: true header); with different data it returns DUPLICATE_OPERATION.

201.description: The new HR user, its audit event, and the one-time temporary password.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, with a reason such as PREVIEW_EXPIRED, PREVIEW_INVALID, PREVIEW_MISMATCH, or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

422.description: INVALID_SCOPE: scopes on an Admin, a Scoped user without a country and a department, or an unknown value.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: database unavailable or a lock wait timed out. Do not assume the change applied; retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Admin HR: regenerate a temporary password
post.description: Account recovery, for example after a lost creation response. Stores only the Argon2id hash of a new random password, revokes every active session, increments the version, and writes one TEMPORARY_PASSWORD_REGENERATED audit event in one transaction, then returns the password once. No email is sent. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key does not regenerate again: it returns temporaryPassword null and credentialRecoveryRequired true. An Admin cannot regenerate their own password (another active Admin must do it).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
